## 🐛 Bug Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior

A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## 📸 Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the problem.

## 🌐 Environment

- **Browser**: [e.g. Chrome 120, Safari 17]
- **OS**: [e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11]
- **Device**: [e.g. MacBook Pro, iPhone 15]
- **Screen size / viewport**: [e.g. 1440×900, 390×844]
- **URL**: [e.g. https://glitterngeek.com/about]

## 🔍 Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here (console errors, network failures, feature flag state, etc.).

## 🏷️ Severity

- [ ] Critical — site is broken or inaccessible
- [ ] High — major feature is broken
- [ ] Medium — minor feature is broken or looks wrong
- [ ] Low — cosmetic / polish issue
